title: Medical Pill Identifier App
description: Build a computer vision app that identifies pills from photos to help patients verify their medications. Uses transfer learning with pre-trained models for quick deployment.

algorithms.name: MobileNetV2 (Transfer Learning)
algorithms.reason: Lightweight, runs on CPU, perfect for beginners. Pre-trained on ImageNet, fine-tune top layers only. Achieves good accuracy with minimal compute.

algorithms.name: EfficientNet-B0
algorithms.reason: Better accuracy than MobileNet with similar model size. Good alternative if MobileNet accuracy is insufficient.

projectSize.trainingTime: ~30 min on GPU / ~3 hours on CPU

platformReason: Dataset ~1.5GB dan butuh GPU untuk training yang efisien. Google Colab T4 GPU gratis sudah lebih dari cukup. Download dataset langsung ke Colab tanpa perlu storage lokal.

phases.name: Phase 1: Setup & Dataset
tasks: Download and explore NIH Pill dataset from Kaggle

phases.name: Phase 2: Model Training
tasks: Fine-tune top layers for pill classification

phases.name: Phase 3: App Development
tasks: Build simple web interface with Streamlit
Add image upload and prediction display
Deploy to Streamlit Cloud or Hugging Face Spaces

resources: Fast.ai course - Lesson on Computer Vision
tips: Start with a small subset of common pills (10-20 classes)
Use data augmentation extensively due to limited medical images
Consider adding confidence thresholds to avoid false positives

title: Stock Market Sentiment Analyzer
description: Analyze financial news and social media to predict market sentiment. Combines NLP with time-series analysis to provide trading insights based on public opinion and news trends.

algorithms.name: FinBERT (BERT fine-tuned for Finance)
algorithms.reason: Pre-trained specifically on financial text. Understands finance jargon far better than general BERT. Available on HuggingFace: ProsusAI/finbert

algorithms.name: VADER (Valence Aware Dictionary)
algorithms.reason: Rule-based, no training needed. Use as a fast baseline before FinBERT. Good for social media text.

algorithms.name: RoBERTa-base fine-tuned on SST
algorithms.reason: Alternative to FinBERT, higher accuracy on general sentiment. Use if FinBERT overfits.

projectSize.trainingTime: ~1 hour on GPU (fine-tuning) / ~6 hours on CPU

platformReason: FinBERT model ~440MB dan fine-tuning butuh GPU. Colab T4 GPU gratis sangat cocok untuk project ini. Bisa run inference setelah training di local.
learningOutcomes: Correlation analysis between sentiment and stock prices

phases.name: Phase 1: Data Collection
tasks: Download Financial PhraseBank dataset from HuggingFace
Collect Reddit WallStreetBets data from Kaggle
Pull historical stock price data via yfinance library

phases.name: Phase 2: Sentiment Model
tasks: Generate sentiment scores per stock ticker

phases.name: Phase 3: Analysis & Dashboard
tasks: Correlate sentiment trends with price movements
Build interactive dashboard with Plotly Dash

resources: FinBERT pre-trained model on Hugging Face: ProsusAI/finbert
Alpha Vantage API for stock data
tips: Be aware of API rate limits
Sentiment is a signal, not a guarantee—add disclaimers

title: Dynamic Pricing Optimization Engine
description: Advanced time-series forecasting system that predicts optimal product prices based on demand, competition, inventory levels, and seasonal patterns. Uses ensemble methods and reinforcement learning.

algorithms.name: LSTM (Long Short-Term Memory)
algorithms.reason: Best for capturing long-term temporal dependencies in pricing patterns. Handles multi-variate time series natively. Primary model for demand forecasting.

algorithms.name: XGBoost + Feature Engineering
algorithms.reason: Excellent for price elasticity modeling. Faster to train than LSTM, interpretable feature importance. Use alongside LSTM in ensemble.

algorithms.name: PPO (Proximal Policy Optimization) - RL
algorithms.reason: For the final pricing decision agent. PPO is stable and works well with continuous action spaces like price ranges.

projectSize.trainingTime: ~3-5 hours on GPU / ~15+ hours on CPU

platformReason: Dataset kecil (<200MB) jadi bisa local, tapi RL training butuh GPU. Rekomendasi: develop & EDA di local, training LSTM + RL di Colab T4 GPU gratis.

phases.name: Phase 1: Research & Data Engineering
tasks: Design data schema for multi-source integration
Build ETL pipeline for data ingestion
Perform extensive EDA on pricing patterns

phases.name: Phase 2: Baseline Models
tasks: Build XGBoost model for price elasticity

phases.name: Phase 3: RL Optimization
tasks: Implement PPO for pricing decisions using Stable-Baselines3

phases.name: Phase 4: Production & Monitoring
tasks: Document API and create user guide

tips: Start with single product category before scaling
Validate with backtesting before live deployment
